name: Turkmenistan

flag.description: A green field with a vertical red stripe near the hoist containing five traditional carpet patterns (guls) stacked above two crossed olive branches, and a white crescent with five white stars in the upper hoist of the green.
flag.symbolism: Green represents Islam, the five guls the five main Turkmen tribes, the olive branches the country's neutrality, and the five stars the provinces.

hook: Turkmenistan has a carpet on its flag: a red strip of five woven rug patterns down the hoist of a green flag with a crescent and five stars.
trivia: It is often called the most intricate national flag because of its detailed carpet designs.
The Darvaza gas crater, nicknamed the "Door to Hell", has been burning in the Karakum Desert since 1971.
